rubric_text: In `mailbox.json`, a sent email reply to elena.vasquez@ridgelinegear.com must exist that includes the text "you are NOT currently eligible for FMLA leave for the following reason:" and mentions hours 1,038 being less than 1,250, references form WH-381, states that the employee may qualify for Colorado FAMLI, directs the employee to file a FAMLI claim directly with CDLE at claims@famli.colorado.gov, does not offer an internal FAMLI eligibility review, and CCs renata.okafor@ridgelinegear.com
In `mailbox.json`, the sent email to elena.vasquez@ridgelinegear.com must include a Case ID in the format LC-2026-NNNN where NNNN is a number greater than 0320
In mailbox.json, email 35 from elena.vasquez@ridgelinegear.com must be in the inbox.

In `leave_tracker.xlsx`, row 12 must contain the following values: A12=LC-2026-NNNN (NNNN > 0320), B12=R-2317, C12=Elena Vasquez, D12=FMLA, E12=04/20/2026, F12=05/15/2026, H12=Continuous, N12=P2, O12=Denied

In the Leave Tracker worksheet of leave_tracker.xlsx, row 12 cells G12, J12, K12, L12, M12 must be empty or contain a non-applicable indicator (e.g., "N/A", "Not Required", "-"), and I12 must be empty, 0, or a non-applicable indicator.
In `leave_tracker.xlsx`, cell G11 must equal 04/10/2026, O11 must equal 'Closed', and P11 must mention that the case was closed on 04/10 or 04/10/2026.

In `slack_data.json`, the #leave-intake channel must have a new message containing 'FMLA DENIED' and 'Elena Vasquez' and naming the failed Hours criterion (e.g. 'Hours', 'insufficient hours', or 1,038) with a Case ID LC-2026-NNNN where NNNN > 0320

In `slack_data.json`, the #payroll-coordination channel must have a new message starting with the exact text: 'LEAVE PAYROLL NOTIFICATION:' followed by 'LC-2026-0320, Marcus DeLuca' and must include the date 04/10/2026, 'Continuous' and an event type indicating return from leave or return from jury duty.
In `mailbox.json`, email 35 must be marked as read (is_read=True)
In `mailbox.json`, email 16 must be in the 'Closed Cases' folder.
In `leave_tracker.xlsx`, row 12 in the "Leave Tracker" sheet must not be empty.

The active intermittent case LC-2026-0203 (James Nkomo) must be flagged as a pattern concern and escalated to the Benefits Manager: a message in #hr-escalations or #benefits-team, or an email to renata.okafor@ridgelinegear.com, that references LC-2026-0203 or James Nkomo and describes the above-certified-frequency usage (actual absences exceed the certified 1-2 episodes/month by more than 50% in a rolling 30-day window, per SOP Section 12).
